title: The Portrait of Bellwether Lane Revisited
author: Emrys Galloway
blurb: Petra Quintana, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
